topic: General Machine Learning->Transfer, Multitask and Meta-learning
title_en: Server-Proximal Aggregation for Federated Domain-Incremental Learning under Partial Participation: Task-Uniform Convergence and Backward Transfer
title_zh: 部分参与下联邦域增量学习的服务器邻近聚合：任务一致收敛与反向迁移

sentences.en: Real-world federated systems seldom operate on static data: input distributions drift while privacy rules forbid raw data sharing.
sentences.zh: 真实世界的联邦系统很少在静态数据上运行：输入分布会发生漂移，而隐私规则禁止共享原始数据。

sentences.en: We study Federated Domain-Incremental Learning (FDIL), where (i) clients are heterogeneous, (ii) tasks arrive sequentially with shifting domains, and (iii) the label space remains fixed.
sentences.zh: 我们研究联邦域增量学习（FDIL），其中（i）客户端是异构的，（ii）任务以不断变化的域顺序到达，且（iii）标签空间保持固定。

sentences.en: Two theoretical pillars remain missing for FDIL under partial participation: a guarantee of backward knowledge transfer (BKT) and a convergence rate that holds *uniformly across the task sequence*.
sentences.zh: 对于部分参与下的FDIL，仍然缺少两个理论支柱：反向知识迁移（BKT）的保证，以及*跨任务序列一致成立*的收敛速率。

sentences.en: We introduce SPECIAL (Server-Proximal Efficient Continual Aggregation for Learning), a simple, replay-free FDIL algorithm that adds a single server-side ``anchor'' to FedAvg: in each round, the server aggregates updates from a uniformly sampled subset of clients and then blends the result with the previous global model via a lightweight proximal step.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了SPECIAL（面向学习的服务器邻近高效持续聚合），一种简单、免回放的FDIL算法，它向FedAvg添加了一个服务端“锚点”：在每一轮中，服务器聚合来自均匀采样子集的客户端的更新，然后通过一个轻量级邻近步骤将结果与先前的全局模型混合。

sentences.en: This anchor curbs cumulative drift without replay buffers, synthetic data, or task-specific heads, leaving communication cost and model size unchanged.
sentences.zh: 该锚点在无需回放缓冲区、合成数据或特定任务头的情况下抑制累积漂移，通信成本和模型大小保持不变。

sentences.en: Our theory shows that SPECIAL (i) *preserves earlier tasks*: a BKT bound caps any increase in earlier-task loss by a drift-controlled term that shrinks with more rounds, local epochs, and participating clients; and (ii) *achieves task-uniform, communication-efficient convergence* for non-convex FDIL with partial participation: $\mathcal{O}\big(\sqrt{E/(NT)}\big)$ in expected gradient norm, with $E$ local epochs, $T$ rounds, and $N$ participating clients, while explicitly separating optimization variance from inter-task drift.
sentences.zh: 我们的理论表明，SPECIAL（i）*保留较早的任务*：一个BKT界将较早任务损失的增幅限制在一个漂移受控项内，该术语随轮次、本地轮数（epoch）和参与客户端的增加而缩小；（ii）对部分参与的非凸FDIL实现*任务一致、通信高效的收敛*：在期望梯度范数上为$\mathcal{O}\big(\sqrt{E/(NT)}\big)$，其中$E$为本地轮数，$T$为轮次，$N$为参与客户端数，同时将优化方差与任务间漂移显式分离。

sentences.en: Experiments on standard FDIL benchmarks corroborate the theory.
sentences.zh: 在标准FDIL基准上的实验验证了该理论。

title_en: Set Diffusion: Interpolating Token Orderings between Autoregression and Diffusion for Fast and Flexible Decoding
title_zh: 集合扩散：在自回归与扩散之间插值token顺序以实现快速灵活解码

sentences.en: Discrete diffusion models have steadily improved in quality relative to autoregressive (AR) models.
sentences.zh: 离散扩散模型相对于自回归（AR）模型，质量一直在稳步提高。

sentences.en: However, these models are normally constrained to fixed-length generation and do not support key-value (KV) caching.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些模型通常被限制为固定长度生成，并且不支持键值（KV）缓存。

sentences.en: Block diffusion partially bridges diffusion and AR by unmasking token blocks left-to-right, but it is still limited to generate fixed-size blocks sequentially.
sentences.zh: 块扩散通过从左到右去掩码token块部分地弥合了扩散与AR之间的鸿沟，但它仍局限于顺序生成固定大小的块。

sentences.en: Here, we present a new class of language models, set diffusion, comprised of (i) a likelihood parameterization that factorizes over flexible-position, flexible-length token sets and (ii) a set-causal diffusion architecture that supports KV cache updates after every inference step.
sentences.zh: 在此，我们提出了一类新的语言模型——集合扩散，它由（i）一个在灵活位置、灵活长度的token集合上分解的似然参数化，以及（ii）一个支持在每次推理步骤后更新KV缓存的集合因果扩散架构组成。

sentences.en: By factorizing over token sets instead of fixed-size blocks, tokens can be decoded in arbitrarily-ordered sets, including sliding-window sets, enabling faster inference and support for any-order decoding.
sentences.zh: 通过在token集合（而非固定大小的块）上进行分解，token可以被按任意顺序的集合解码，包括滑动窗口集合，从而实现更快的推理并支持任意顺序解码。

sentences.en: Set diffusion achieves better speed-quality tradeoffs on mathematical reasoning, summarization, and unconditional generation compared to prior diffusion language models while offering stronger infilling performance than block diffusion.
sentences.zh: 在数学推理、摘要和无条件生成方面，集合扩散相比先前的扩散语言模型取得了更好的速度-质量权衡，同时提供了比块扩散更强的插值补全性能。

sentences.en: We provide the code, along with the model weights and blog post on the project page: [https://m-arriola.com/setdlms/](https://m-arriola.com/setdlms/)
sentences.zh: 我们提供了代码、模型权重以及项目页面上的博客文章：[https://m-arriola.com/setdlms/](https://m-arriola.com/setdlms/)。

title_en: Set-Coupled Guidance: Set-Level Coordination in Diffusion-Based Dataset Distillation
title_zh: 集合耦合引导：扩散基数据集蒸馏中的集合级协调

sentences.en: Diffusion models serve as generative priors for dataset distillation, yet existing pipelines rely on per-sample update rules that evolve each synthetic image independently, limiting their ability to optimize collective set-level objectives.
sentences.zh: 扩散模型作为数据集蒸馏的生成先验，但现有流程依赖逐样本更新规则，每个合成图像独立演化，限制了它们优化集体集合级目标的能力。

sentences.en: We propose Set-Coupled Guidance (SCG), a plug-and-play auxiliary controller that shifts from per-image to group (IPC-at-once) sampling by injecting set-symmetric feedback at each diffusion step.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了集合耦合引导（SCG），一个即插即用的辅助控制器，通过在每个扩散步骤注入集合对称反馈，从逐图像采样转向成组（一次IPC）采样。

sentences.en: SCG combines spectral set-point regulation, which aligns set-level statistics to real data via empirical characteristic function matching, with cooperative kernel coupling that stabilizes joint trajectories under noisy feedback.
sentences.zh: SCG结合了频谱设定点调节（通过经验特征函数匹配将集合级统计与真实数据对齐）与协同核耦合（在噪声反馈下稳定联合轨迹）。

sentences.en: All computations operate on lightweight descriptors extracted from predicted clean latents, adding low overhead to the base method.
sentences.zh: 所有计算都在从预测的清洁潜在变量提取的轻量级描述符上进行，为基方法增添的开销很低。

sentences.en: We provide theoretical analysis including Lyapunov descent and input-to-state stability for distributional tracking.
sentences.zh: 我们提供了理论分析，包括用于分布跟踪的Lyapunov下降和输入-状态稳定性。

sentences.en: Experiments on ImageNette, ImageWoof, ImageNet-100 and ImageNet-1K show consistent accuracy gains across multiple diffusion-based baselines; code is available at \url{https://github.com/tade1s/SCG}.
sentences.zh: 在ImageNette、ImageWoof、ImageNet-100和ImageNet-1K上的实验表明，多个扩散基基线均获得一致的准确率提升；代码可在\url{https://github.com/tade1s/SCG}获取。

title_en: Set-Preserving Calibration from Conformal P-Values to E-Values
title_zh: 从保形p值到e值的保集校准

sentences.en: Standard conformal prediction (CP) procedures are typically formulated in terms of p-values, but reliance on p-values alone limits flexibility, for example, when combining dependent evidence across models or data splits.
sentences.zh: 标准保形预测（CP）流程通常以p值形式表述，但仅依赖p值限制了灵活性，例如在跨模型或数据划分组合相关证据时。

sentences.en: Recent work has explored e-value formulations for conformal inference, yet a direct connection between p- and e-value formulations in CP has been missing, especially regarding their statistical efficiency.
sentences.zh: 近期工作探索了用于保形推断的e值表述，然而CP中p值表述与e值表述之间的直接联系一直缺失，尤其是在统计效率方面。

sentences.en: We first identify limitations of classical p-to-e calibrators in the CP setting, showing that they are not set-preserving and can lead to overly conservative prediction sets.
sentences.zh: 我们首先识别了CP设置中经典p到e校准器的局限性，表明它们不保集，且可能导致过度保守的预测集。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose a novel P2E calibrator that converts conformal p-values into e-values without altering the prediction set induced by the original conformal p-value.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新的P2E校准器，它在不改变原始保形p值所诱导的预测集的情况下，将保形p值转换为e值。

sentences.en: We establish both theoretically and empirically that our calibrator can yield significant efficiency gains over existing p-to-e calibrators.
sentences.zh: 我们在理论和经验上均表明，我们的校准器可以比现有p到e校准器带来显著的效率提升。

sentences.en: This e-value formulation enables principled use of recent advances in e-value merging and randomization, where we demonstrate its impact in two applications: cross-conformal prediction (CCP), whose variants typically provide only approximate $1-2\alpha$ coverage, and conformal aggregation (CA).
sentences.zh: 这种e值表述使得能够原则性地利用e值合并与随机化的最新进展，我们展示其在两个应用中的影响：交叉保形预测（CCP）（其变体通常仅提供近似的$1-2\alpha$覆盖率）和保形聚合（CA）。

sentences.en: In both cases, our e-value-based methods satisfy the desired $1-\alpha$ coverage guarantee while improving efficiency over standard baselines.
sentences.zh: 在这两种情况下，我们基于e值的方法都满足期望的$1-\alpha$覆盖率保证，同时在效率上优于标准基线。

sentences.en: More broadly, our approach expands the flexibility of CP and opens new directions for efficient, distribution-free uncertainty quantification.
sentences.zh: 更广泛地说，我们的方法扩展了CP的灵活性，并为高效、无分布的量化不确定性开辟了新的方向。

title_en: SetPO: Set-Level Policy Optimization for Diversity-Preserving LLM Reasoning
title_zh: SetPO：面向保持多样性的LLM推理的集合级策略优化

sentences.en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has shown notable effectiveness in enhancing large language models (LLMs) reasoning performance, especially in mathematics tasks.
sentences.zh: 带可验证奖励的强化学习在提升大语言模型（LLM）推理性能方面已显示出显著有效性，尤其是在数学任务中。

sentences.en: However, such improvements often come with reduced outcome diversity, where the model concentrates probability mass on a narrow set of solutions.
sentences.zh: 然而，这种改进往往伴随着结果多样性的降低，模型将概率质量集中在较窄的解集上。

sentences.en: Motivated by diminishing-returns principles, we introduce a set level diversity objective defined over sampled trajectories using kernelized similarity.
sentences.zh: 受边际收益递减原则的启发，我们引入了一个在采样轨迹上使用核化相似度定义的集合级多样性目标。

sentences.en: Our approach derives a leave-one-out marginal contribution for each sampled trajectory and integrates this objective as a plug-in advantage shaping term for policy optimization.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法为每条采样轨迹推导出一个留一法的边际贡献，并将该目标作为插拔式的优势塑形项整合到策略优化中。

sentences.en: We further investigate the contribution of a single trajectory to language model diversity within a distribution perturbation framework.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步在分布扰动框架中研究单条轨迹对语言模型多样性的贡献。

sentences.en: This analysis theoretically confirms a monotonicity property, proving that rarer trajectories yield consistently higher marginal contributions to the global diversity.
sentences.zh: 这一分析在理论上确认了一个单调性性质，证明更稀有的轨迹对全局多样性总是产生更高的边际贡献。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across a range of model scales demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed algorithm, consistently outperforming strong baselines in both Pass@1 and Pass@K across various benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 在多种模型规模上的大量实验证明了我们算法的有效性，它在各种基准上的Pass@1和Pass@K上都持续优于强基线。

title_en: SF-Mamba: Rethinking State Space Model for Vision
title_zh: SF-Mamba：重新思考视觉的状态空间模型

sentences.en: Visual Mamba models have recently emerged as alternatives to Vision Transformers (ViTs), which suffer from quadratic complexity.
sentences.zh: 视觉Mamba模型近来作为视觉Transformer（ViT）的替代方案出现，后者存在二次复杂度的问题。

sentences.en: While the recurrent scanning mechanism of Mamba offers computational efficiency, it inherently limits non-causal interactions between image patches.
sentences.zh: 虽然Mamba的循环扫描机制提供了计算效率，但它内在限制了图像块之间的非因果交互。

sentences.en: Prior works have attempted to address this limitation through various multi-scan strategies; however, these approaches suffer from inefficiencies due to suboptimal scan designs and frequent data rearrangement.
sentences.zh: 先前的工作试图通过各种多扫描策略来解决这一局限；然而，这些方法因扫描设计次优和频繁的数据重排而效率低下。

sentences.en: Moreover, Mamba exhibits relatively slow computational speed under short token lengths, commonly used in visual tasks.
sentences.zh: 此外，Mamba在视觉任务中常用的短token长度下表现出相对较慢的计算速度。

sentences.en: In pursuit of a truly efficient vision encoder, we rethink the scan operation for vision and the computational efficiency of Mamba.
sentences.zh: 为追求真正高效的视觉编码器，我们重新思考了面向视觉的扫描操作以及Mamba的计算效率。

sentences.en: To this end, we propose SF-Mamba, a novel visual Mamba with two key proposals: auxiliary patch **swapping** for encoding bidirectional information flow under an unidirectional scan and batch **folding** with periodic state reset for advanced GPU parallelism.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们提出了SF-Mamba，一种新颖的视觉Mamba，包含两个关键提议：用于在单向扫描下编码双向信息流的辅助补丁**交换（swapping）**，以及用于先进GPU并行度的带周期性状态重置的批量**折叠（folding）**。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on image classification, object detection, and instance and semantic segmentation consistently demonstrate that our proposed SF-Mamba significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines while improving throughput across different model sizes.
sentences.zh: 在图像分类、目标检测以及实例和语义分割上的大量实验一致表明，我们提出的SF-Mamba显著优于最先进的基线，同时在不同模型规模下提高了吞吐量。

sentences.en: The source code is available at: https://github.com/sony/SF-Mamba.
sentences.zh: 源代码可在 https://github.com/sony/SF-Mamba 获取。

title_en: SFCLTA: Spectral Fusion Contrastive Learning with Topology-Adaptive Graph Augmentation
title_zh: SFCLTA：带拓扑自适应图增强的频谱融合对比学习

sentences.en: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have achieved remarkable success in graph analysis due to the Message-Passing (MP) mechanism, yet they struggle with heterophilic graphs where connected nodes often have distinct labels or dissimilar attributes.
sentences.zh: 图神经网络（GNN）凭借消息传递（MP）机制在图分析中取得了显著的成功，但它们在异质图（其中相连节点往往具有不同标签或不同属性）上仍有困难。

sentences.en: Graph Contrastive Learning (GCL) serves as a promising approach to extract the information beyond neighboring nodes, effectively mitigating the limitations of the MP mechanism in handling heterophilic graphs.
sentences.zh: 图对比学习（GCL）是提取邻接节点之外信息的一种有前景的方法，可有效缓解MP机制在处理异质图时的局限性。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, GCL faces two critical challenges when applied to heterophilic graphs, i.e., the potential distribution shift from data augmentation and the loss of robustness caused by high-frequency signals.
sentences.zh: 然而，GCL在应用于异质图时面临两个关键挑战，即数据增强带来的潜在分布偏移，以及高频信号导致的鲁棒性损失。

sentences.en: To address these problems, we propose a novel model, namely the Spectral Fusion Contrastive Learning with Topology-Adaptive Graph Augmentation (SFCLTA) for unsupervised graph representation learning.
sentences.zh: 为解决这些问题，我们提出了一种新颖的模型，即带拓扑自适应图增强的频谱融合对比学习（SFCLTA），用于无监督图表示学习。

sentences.en: Our method dynamically adjusts graph structures via a heterophily-aware augmentation strategy, and constrains high-frequency distortions by spectral regularization.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法通过异质性感知增强策略动态调整图结构，并通过频谱正则化约束高频失真。

sentences.en: We utilize the confidence-weighted fusion to enhance the robustness.
sentences.zh: 我们利用置信度加权融合来增强鲁棒性。

sentences.en: Additionally, we introduce a feature reconstruction task as a prerequisite to explicitly mitigate feature-level distribution shifts.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们引入特征重建任务作为前置步骤，以显式缓解特征级分布偏移。

sentences.en: Experiments on multiple real-world datasets demonstrate that the proposed SFCLTA consistently outperforms baseline models in multiple tasks.
sentences.zh: 在多个真实数据集上的实验表明，所提出的SFCLTA在多个任务上持续优于基线模型。

sentences.en: Our code is released on https://github.com/JonathanGXu/SFCLTA.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码已在 https://github.com/JonathanGXu/SFCLTA 发布。

title_en: SFedPO: Streaming Federated Learning with a Prediction Oracle under Temporal Shifts
title_zh: SFedPO：时间偏移下带预测预言机的流式联邦学习

sentences.en: Federated Learning (FL) enables decentralized clients to collaboratively train a global model without sharing raw data.
sentences.zh: 联邦学习（FL）使去中心化客户端能够在无需共享原始数据的情况下协作训练全局模型。

sentences.en: However, most existing FL frameworks assume that clients train on static local datasets collected in advance or that the data follows a fixed underlying distribution, which limits their applicability in dynamic environments where data evolves over time.
sentences.zh: 然而，大多数现有FL框架假设客户端在预先收集的静态本地数据集上训练，或假设数据遵循固定的底层分布，这限制了它们在数据随时间演变的动态环境中的适用性。

sentences.en: A parallel line of research, online FL, removes all assumptions and adopts an adversarial perspective, but this approach is often overly pessimistic and neglects the structured, partially predictable nature of real-world data dynamics.
sentences.zh: 并行的研究路线——在线FL——去除了所有假设并采用对抗视角，但这种方法往往过于悲观，忽视了真实世界数据动态的结构化、部分可预测的本质。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we propose SFedPO, a streaming federated learning framework that incorporates a prediction oracle to capture the temporal evolution of client-side data distributions.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一差距，我们提出了SFedPO，一个流式联邦学习框架，它引入预测预言机来捕捉客户端侧数据分布的时间演化。

sentences.en: We theoretically analyze the convergence bounds of SFedPO and develop two practical sampling strategies: a Distribution-guided Data Sampling (DDS) strategy that dynamically selects training data under limited storage by balancing historical reuse and distribution adaptation, and a Shift-aware Aggregation Weights (SAW) mechanism that modulates global aggregation based on client-specific sampling behaviors.
sentences.zh: 我们在理论上分析了SFedPO的收敛界，并开发了两种实用的采样策略：分布引导数据采样（DDS）策略（在有限存储下通过平衡历史复用与分布适应来动态选择训练数据），以及偏移感知聚合权重（SAW）机制（根据客户端特定的采样行为调节全局聚合）。

sentences.en: We further establish robustness guarantees under prediction errors.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步在预测误差下建立了鲁棒性保证。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that SFedPO effectively adapts to streaming scenarios with distribution shifts and significantly outperforms existing methods.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，SFedPO能够有效适应具有分布偏移的流式场景，并显著优于现有方法。

title_en: SG2Loc: Sequential Visual Localization on 3D Scene Graphs
title_zh: SG2Loc：基于3D场景图的序贯视觉定位

sentences.en: Visual localization in complex indoor environments remains a critical challenge for robotics and AR applications.
sentences.zh: 复杂室内环境中的视觉定位对于机器人和AR应用仍是一个关键挑战。

sentences.en: Sequential localization, where pose estimates are refined over time, is important for autonomous agents.
sentences.zh: 序贯定位——随时间不断精化位姿估计——对自主智能体十分重要。

sentences.en: However, traditional methods often require storing extensive image databases or point clouds, leading to significant overhead.
sentences.zh: 然而，传统方法往往需要存储大量的图像数据库或点云，带来显著的开销。

sentences.en: This paper introduces a novel, lightweight approach to sequential visual localization using 3D scene graphs.
sentences.zh: 本文介绍了一种使用3D场景图进行序贯视觉定位的新颖轻量级方法。

sentences.en: Our method represents the environment with a compact scene graph, where nodes represent objects (with coarse meshes) and edges encode spatial relationships.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法用一个紧凑的场景图表示环境，其中节点表示对象（带有粗略网格），边编码空间关系。

sentences.en: For each image in the localization phase, we extract per-patch semantic features, predicting object identities.
sentences.zh: 在定位阶段的每张图像中，我们提取逐补丁的语义特征，预测对象身份。

sentences.en: Localization is performed within a particle filter framework.
sentences.zh: 定位在粒子滤波框架内进行。

sentences.en: Each particle, representing a camera pose, projects the coarse object meshes from the scene graph into the image, assigning object identities to patches based on visibility.
sentences.zh: 每个粒子表示一个相机位姿，将场景图中的粗略对象网格投影到图像中，根据可见性为补丁分配对象身份。

sentences.en: The similarity of the per-patch features, in the input image, and object features from the scene graph determines the weight of a particle.
sentences.zh: 输入图像中的逐补丁特征与场景图对象特征的相似性决定了粒子的权重。

sentences.en: Subsequent images are incorporated sequentially, refining the pose estimate.
sentences.zh: 后续图像被序贯地整合进来，不断精化位姿估计。

sentences.en: By leveraging a compact scene graph and efficient semantic matching, our method significantly reduces storage while maintaining performance on real-world datasets.
sentences.zh: 通过利用紧凑的场景图和高效的语义匹配，我们的方法在保持真实数据集性能的同时显著减少了存储。

sentences.en: The code is available at https://github.com/DmblnNicole/sg2loc.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/DmblnNicole/sg2loc 获取。

title_en: SGERA: Stein-Guided ECG-Report Alignment for ECG Representation Learning
title_zh: SGERA：用于ECG表示学习的Stein引导ECG-报告对齐

sentences.en: Electrocardiogram (ECG) representation learning via ECG-report alignment is often hindered by the inherent structural and statistical divergence between signals and natural language.
sentences.zh: 通过ECG-报告对齐进行心电图（ECG）表示学习，常受到信号与自然语言之间固有结构与统计差异的阻碍。

sentences.en: Existing methods struggle to bridge this gap with simple contrastive objectives, but struggle with distribution dependencies between heterogeneous features.
sentences.zh: 现有方法试图用简单的对比目标弥合这一差距，但在处理异构特征之间的分布依赖性时存在困难。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose **SGERA** (**S**tein-**G**uided **E**CG-**R**eport **A**lignment), which leverages the unique properties of Stein kernels to provide a more rigorous geometric alignment in the latent space: **instance-level** alignment via a Stein-RBF kernel enforces pairwise consistency between ECG and report embeddings and **distribution-level** alignment via a Stein-Score kernel captures higher-order interactions for global alignment.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了**SGERA**（**S**tein-**G**uided **E**CG-**R**eport **A**lignment，Stein引导的ECG-报告对齐），利用Stein核的独特性质在潜在空间中实现更严格的几何对齐：通过Stein-RBF核的**实例级**对齐强制执行ECG与报告嵌入之间的成对一致性，而通过Stein-Score核的**分布级**对齐捕捉高阶交互以实现全局对齐。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we introduce an ECG-Report matching task with a Hard Sample Mining strategy to refine discriminative boundaries.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们引入了一个带难样本挖掘策略的ECG-报告匹配任务，以细化判别边界。

sentences.en: Experiments across three public datasets demonstrate that SGERA significantly outperforms state-of-the-art SSL methods in zero-shot classification, linear probing, and transfer learning, proving the superiority of Stein-guided alignment in handling complex medical modalities.
sentences.zh: 在三个公开数据集上的实验表明，SGERA在零样本分类、线性探测和迁移学习方面显著优于最先进的自监督学习方法，证明了Stein引导对齐在处理复杂医学模态时的优越性。

sentences.en: Code is available at supplementary materials.
sentences.zh: 代码见补充材料。

title_en: SGMD: Score Gradient Matching Distillation for Few-Step Video Diffusion Distillation
title_zh: SGMD：面向少步视频扩散蒸馏的分数梯度匹配蒸馏

sentences.en: Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) is a widely used paradigm for accelerating inference in few-step video diffusion models.
sentences.zh: 分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）是加速少步视频扩散模型推理的广泛使用的范式。

sentences.en: However, DMD-style training faces a structural bottleneck: the student-side auxiliary score network (the fake score) must closely track a continuously evolving generator.
sentences.zh: 然而，DMD式训练面临一个结构性瓶颈：学生侧的辅助分数网络（虚假分数）必须紧密跟踪一个持续演化的生成器。

sentences.en: Updating the fake score too frequently increases training cost and can over-emphasize inner-loop tracking, while infrequent updates lead to tracking lag that destabilizes training and degrades generation consistency.
sentences.zh: 过频繁地更新虚假分数会增加训练成本，并可能过度强调内环跟踪；而更新不频繁则会导致跟踪滞后，使训练不稳定并损害生成一致性。

sentences.en: To address this issue, we propose \textbf{Score Gradient Matching Distillation (SGMD)}.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了\textbf{Score Gradient Matching Distillation (SGMD)}（分数梯度匹配蒸馏）。

sentences.en: SGMD adopts a fake-score perspective by directly optimizing the fake score toward the teacher, while using teacher stop-gradient Fisher as a stable distribution-matching objective.
sentences.zh: SGMD采用虚假分数视角，直接优化虚假分数使其朝教师逼近，同时使用教师stop-gradient Fisher作为稳定的分布匹配目标。

sentences.en: We provide a gradient analysis that motivates this objective choice under ideal tracking.
sentences.zh: 我们提供了一种梯度分析，为理想跟踪下的这一目标选择提供了动机。

sentences.en: Building on this, SGMD introduces a pair of dual potentials: negative-residual (NR) for outer-loop correction and residual-contraction (RC) for inner-loop tracking.
sentences.zh: 在此基础上，SGMD引入一对对偶势能：负残差（NR）用于外环校正，残差收缩（RC）用于内环跟踪。

sentences.en: Empirically, compared to DMD, SGMD achieves an approximately $\sim 3\times$ training speedup and substantially improves motion dynamics for 4-step distilled models while preserving temporal consistency.
sentences.zh: 实验上，与DMD相比，SGMD实现了$\sim 3\times$的训练加速，并大幅改善了4步蒸馏模型的运动动力学，同时保持了时间一致性。

title_en: SHAP-Guided Kernel Actor-Critic for Explainable Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: SHAP引导的核Actor-Critic用于可解释强化学习

sentences.en: Actor-critic (AC) methods are a cornerstone of reinforcement learning (RL) but offer limited interpretability.
sentences.zh: Actor-Critic（AC）方法是强化学习（RL）的基石，但可解释性有限。

sentences.en: Current explainable RL methods seldom use \emph{state attributions} to assist training.
sentences.zh: 当前的可解释RL方法很少使用\emph{状态归因}来辅助训练。

sentences.en: Rather, they treat all state features equally, thereby neglecting the heterogeneous impacts of individual state dimensions on the reward.
sentences.zh: 相反，它们将所有状态特征同等对待，从而忽略了各个状态维度对奖励的异质性影响。

sentences.en: We propose *RKHS-SHAP-based Advanced Actor-Critic (RSA2C)*, an attribution-aware, kernelized, two-timescale AC algorithm, including Actor, Value Critic, and Advantage Critic.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了*基于RKHS-SHAP的高级Actor-Critic（RSA2C）*，一个归因感知、核化的双时间尺度AC算法，包括Actor、Value Critic和Advantage Critic。

sentences.en: The Actor is instantiated in a vector-valued reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) with a Mahalanobis-weighted operator-valued kernel, while the Value Critic and Advantage Critic reside in scalar RKHSs.
sentences.zh: Actor在向量值再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）中实例化，使用马氏加权算子值核，而Value Critic和Advantage Critic驻留在标量RKHS中。

sentences.en: These RKHS-enhanced components use sparsified dictionaries: the Value Critic maintains its own dictionary, while the Actor and Advantage Critic share one.
sentences.zh: 这些RKHS增强组件使用稀疏化词典：Value Critic维护自己的词典，而Actor和Advantage Critic共享一个词典。

sentences.en: State attributions, computed from the Value Critic via RKHS-SHAP (kernel mean embedding for on-manifold and conditional mean embedding for off-manifold expectations), are converted into Mahalanobis-gated weights that modulate Actor gradients and Advantage Critic targets.
sentences.zh: 通过RKHS-SHAP（流形上期望用核均值嵌入、流形外期望用条件均值嵌入）从Value Critic计算出的状态归因，被转换为马氏门控权重，用于调节Actor梯度和Advantage Critic目标。

sentences.en: We derive a global, non-asymptotic convergence bound under *state perturbations*, showing stability through the perturbation-error term and efficiency through the convergence-error term.
sentences.zh: 我们推导出*状态扰动*下的全局非渐近收敛界，通过扰动误差项显示稳定性，通过收敛误差项显示效率。

sentences.en: Empirical results on three continuous-control environments show that RSA2C achieves efficiency, stability, and interpretability.
sentences.zh: 在三个连续控制环境上的实验结果表明，RSA2C实现了效率、稳定性和可解释性。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/Na-Li66/RSA2C.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/Na-Li66/RSA2C 获取。

title_en: ShapCCS: Shapley-Driven Client Coreset Selection in Federated Learning
title_zh: ShapCCS：联邦学习中Shapley驱动的客户端核心集选择

sentences.en: Computation overhead has emerged as a critical bottleneck in Federated Learning (FL).
sentences.zh: 计算开销已成为联邦学习（FL）中的关键瓶颈。

sentences.en: Coreset selection tackles this challenge by constructing an informative subset to represent the full dataset.
sentences.zh: 核心集选择通过构建一个信息丰富的子集来代表完整数据集，从而应对这一挑战。

sentences.en: However, existing approaches optimize coreset construction solely at the data level and enforce a uniform retention ratio across all clients, ignoring client heterogeneity and introducing detrimental fragmented clients.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法仅在数据层面优化核心集构建，并在所有客户端上强制统一的保留比例，忽视了客户端异质性并引入了有害的碎片化客户端。

sentences.en: In this paper, we first introduce a *gradient projection Shapley value* (GPSV) to evaluate client contributions.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们首先引入一个*梯度投影Shapley值*（GPSV）来评估客户端贡献。

sentences.en: GPSV captures both the directional and magnitude information of client updates and enables exact Shapley value calculation with $\mathcal{O}(1)$ per-coalition evaluation.
sentences.zh: GPSV同时捕捉客户端更新的方向信息和幅度信息，并能够以每次联盟评估$\mathcal{O}(1)$的计算量实现精确的Shapley值计算。

sentences.en: Building on GPSV, we then propose ShapCCS, the first client-level coreset selection strategy for FL.
sentences.zh: 基于GPSV，我们随后提出了ShapCCS，首个面向FL的客户端级核心集选择策略。

sentences.en: ShapCCS prioritizes clients with high GPSV scores while excluding fragmented clients with negligible or even negative GPSV.
sentences.zh: ShapCCS优先选择GPSV得分高的客户端，同时排除GPSV可忽略甚至为负的碎片化客户端。

sentences.en: As a client-level coreset selection strategy, ShapCCS can be integrated with a data-level selection approach, and additionally reduces communication costs, an advantage unattainable by data-level methods alone.
sentences.zh: 作为一种客户端级核心集选择策略，ShapCCS可以与数据级选择方法集成，并且还能降低通信成本，这是仅靠数据级方法无法获得的优势。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of ShapCCS on model performance and robustness to noise.
sentences.zh: 大量实验证明了ShapCCS在模型性能和噪声鲁棒性方面的优越性。

sentences.en: The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ShapCCS-5CBB.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ShapCCS-5CBB 获取。

title_en: Shape of Thought: Progressive Object Assembly via Visual Chain-of-Thought
title_zh: 思维形状：通过视觉思维链进行渐进式物体组装

sentences.en: Multimodal models for text-to-image generation have achieved strong visual fidelity, yet they remain brittle under compositional structural constraints—notably generative numeracy, attribute binding, and part-level relations.
sentences.zh: 用于文生图生成的多模态模型已实现强大的视觉保真度，但在组合结构约束下仍很脆弱——尤其是生成计数能力、属性绑定和部件级关系。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we propose **Shape-of-Thought (SoT)**, a visual CoT framework for *process-supervised progressive shape assembly in the rendered 2D domain*, without external engines at inference time.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了**Shape-of-Thought (SoT)**（思维形状），一个用于*渲染2D域中的过程监督渐进式形状组装*的视觉CoT框架，推理时不依赖外部引擎。

sentences.en: SoT trains a unified multimodal autoregressive model to generate interleaved textual plans and rendered intermediate states, helping the model capture shape-assembly logic without producing explicit geometric representations.
sentences.zh: SoT训练一个统一的多模态自回归模型，生成交织的文本计划和渲染的中间状态，帮助模型捕捉形状组装逻辑，而无需产生显式几何表示。

sentences.en: Unlike text-only CoT, each decision is grounded in a rendered state, making counts, attachments, topology, and intermediate part-addition errors inspectable across the trajectory.
sentences.zh: 与纯文本CoT不同，每个决策都以渲染状态为基础，使得计数、连接、拓扑和中间部件添置错误在整个轨迹中都可被检查。

sentences.en: To support this paradigm, we introduce **SoT-26K**, a large-scale dataset of grounded assembly traces derived from part-based CAD hierarchies, and **T2S-CompBench**, a benchmark for evaluating structural integrity and trace faithfulness.
sentences.zh: 为支持这一范式，我们引入了**SoT-26K**，一个基于部件CAD层级导出的接地组装轨迹的大规模数据集，以及**T2S-CompBench**，一个用于评估结构完整性和轨迹忠实度的基准。

sentences.en: Fine-tuning on SoT-26K achieves 88.4\% on component numeracy and 84.8\% on structural topology, outperforming direct generation by +24.2 points on component numeracy and +19.3 points on structural topology.
sentences.zh: 在SoT-26K上微调在组件计数上达到88.4\%、在结构拓扑上达到84.8\%，在组件计数上比直接生成高出+24.2个百分点，在结构拓扑上高出+19.3个百分点。

sentences.en: SoT establishes a transparent testbed for rendered-domain structure-aware generation.
sentences.zh: SoT为渲染域中结构感知生成建立了一个透明的测试平台。

sentences.en: The code is available at https://github.com/yuhuo03/Shape-of-Thought.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/yuhuo03/Shape-of-Thought 获取。

topic: General Machine Learning->Transfer, Multitask and Meta-learning
title_en: Shapley Neuron Values for Continual Learning: Which Neurons Matter Most?
title_zh: 持续学习的Shapley神经元值：哪些神经元最重要？

sentences.en: Continual learning enables neural networks to learn tasks sequentially without forgetting previously acquired knowledge.
sentences.zh: 持续学习使神经网络能够在不遗忘先前习得知识的情况下按顺序学习任务。

sentences.en: However, neural networks suffer from catastrophic forgetting, where learning new tasks degrades performance on earlier ones.
sentences.zh: 然而，神经网络存在灾难性遗忘问题，即学习新任务会损害在较早任务上的性能。

sentences.en: We address this problem with **Shapley Neuron Valuation (SNV)**, a principled framework that quantifies Neuron importance in continual learning, grounded in cooperative game theory.
sentences.zh: 我们通过**Shapley神经元估值（SNV）**来解决这一问题，这是一个基于合作博弈论的、量化持续学习中神经元重要性的原则性框架。

sentences.en: SNV selectively freezes important Neurons while keeping others plastic, enabling **buffer-free** continual learning without expanding architecture.
sentences.zh: SNV选择性地冻结重要神经元，同时保持其他神经元的可塑性，从而在无需扩大架构的情况下实现**无缓冲区**的持续学习。

sentences.en: Experiments on ImageNet-1k show that SNV consistently outperforms existing buffer-free methods.
sentences.zh: 在ImageNet-1k上的实验表明，SNV始终优于现有的无缓冲区方法。

sentences.en: In particular, SNV improves accuracy by **+2.88\%** in the class incremental learning and **+6.46\%** in the task incremental learning scenarios compared to the second baseline.
sentences.zh: 特别是，与第二强基线相比，SNV在类增量学习场景中提升了**+2.88\%**的准确率，在任务增量学习场景中提升了**+6.46\%**。

title_en: Shapley Regularized Neural Granger Causality
title_zh: Shapley正则化的神经Granger因果性

sentences.en: Identifying temporal causal structure is fundamental to understanding complex systems.
sentences.zh: 识别时间因果结构是理解复杂系统的基础。

sentences.en: Neural Granger causality has emerged as a powerful paradigm for this task, leveraging the expressiveness of neural networks to model intricate nonlinear dynamics.
sentences.zh: 神经Granger因果性已成为此项任务的一种强大范式，它利用神经网络的表达能力来建模复杂的非线性动力学。

sentences.en: Although complex architectures excel at predictive modeling, existing methods typically rely on simple local measures for causal discovery, which extract only partial information from the learned model and may miss global dependencies.
sentences.zh: 虽然复杂架构在预测建模上表现出色，但现有方法通常依赖简单的局部度量来进行因果发现，这些度量只能从学习到的模型中提取部分信息，可能会遗漏全局依赖关系。

sentences.en: To address this issue, we reformulate Granger causality as a feature attribution problem and propose the Information-Theoretic Shapley value (Info-Shap) to measure global feature importance.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们将Granger因果性重新表述为一个特征归因问题，并提出信息论Shapley值（Info-Shap）来度量全局特征重要性。

sentences.en: We first establish the theoretical equivalence between zero Info-Shap and Granger non-causality.
sentences.zh: 我们首先建立了零Info-Shap与Granger非因果性之间的理论等价。

sentences.en: On top of this, we construct two novel regularizers to suppress spurious relationships and mitigate overfitting.
sentences.zh: 在此基础上，我们构建了两个新颖的正则化器来抑制虚假关系并缓解过拟合。

sentences.en: These regularizers are model-agnostic and can be seamlessly integrated into the training of any differentiable neural network.
sentences.zh: 这些正则化器是模型无关的，可以无缝集成到任何可微神经网络的训练中。

sentences.en: Through extensive experiments on synthetic and realistic datasets, we demonstrate that our method robustly recovers the underlying causal relationships, providing a flexible tool for causal discovery in high-dimensional nonlinear time series.
sentences.zh: 通过在合成和真实数据集上的大量实验，我们证明我们的方法能够稳健地恢复潜在的因果关系，为高维非线性时间序列中的因果发现提供了一种灵活的工具。

title_en: Shared Lexical Task Representations Explain Behavioral Variability In LLMs
title_zh: 共享的词法任务表征解释LLM中的行为变异性

sentences.en: One of the most common complaints about large language models (LLMs) is their prompt sensitivity---that is, the fact that their ability to perform a task or provide a correct answer to a question can depend unpredictably on the way the question is posed.
sentences.zh: 关于大语言模型（LLM）最常见的抱怨之一是它们的提示敏感性——即它们执行任务或对问题给出正确答案的能力会以不可预测的方式依赖于问题的表述方式。

sentences.en: We investigate this variation by comparing two very different but commonly-used styles of prompting: *instruction-based* prompts, which describe the task in natural language, and *example-based* prompts, which provide in-context few-shot demonstration pairs to illustrate the task.
sentences.zh: 我们通过比较两种非常不同但常用的提示风格来研究这种变异：*基于指令的*提示（以自然语言描述任务）和*基于示例的*提示（提供上下文中的少样本示范对来说明任务）。

sentences.en: We find that, despite large variation in performance as a function of the prompt, the model engages some common underlying  mechanisms across different prompts of a task.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，尽管性能随提示变化很大，但模型在不同提示下会调用一些共同的底层机制。

sentences.en: Specifically, we identify task-specific attention heads whose outputs literally describe the task --- which we dub *lexical task heads*---and show that these heads are shared across prompting styles and trigger subsequent answer production.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们识别出任务特定的注意力头，其输出字面上描述了该任务——我们称之为*词法任务头*——并表明这些头在提示风格之间是共享的，并触发随后的答案生成。

sentences.en: We further find that behavioral variation between prompts can be explained by the degree to which these heads are activated, and that failures are at least sometimes due to competing task representations that dilute the signal of the target task.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步发现，提示之间的行为差异可以通过这些头被激活的程度来解释，并且失败至少有时是由于相互竞争的任务表征稀释了目标任务的信号。

sentences.en: Our results together present an increasingly clear picture of how LLMs' internal representations can explain behavior that otherwise seems idiosyncratic to users and developers.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果共同描绘了一幅日益清晰的图景，说明LLM的内部表征如何解释那些在用户和开发者看来似乎因人而异的行为。

title_en: Shared Semantics, Divergent Mechanisms: Unsupervised Feature Discovery by Aligning Semantics and Mechanisms
title_zh: 共享语义，分歧机制：通过对齐语义与机制的无监督特征发现

sentences.en: As large language models are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings, there is a growing need for tools that audit not only model outputs but also the internal computations that produce them.
sentences.zh: 随着大语言模型越来越多地被部署在高风险场景中，人们越来越需要既能审计模型输出、又能审计产生这些输出的内部计算的工具。

sentences.en: Circuit analysis is a central approach in mechanistic interpretability, but it is typically target-conditioned, explaining a single prompt paired with a chosen completion.
sentences.zh: 回路分析是机械可解释性的核心方法，但它通常是目标条件的，只解释单个提示与其选定补全配对的机制。

sentences.en: This target-conditioned setup obscures mechanistic heterogeneity and hinders scalable discovery.
sentences.zh: 这种目标条件式设置掩盖了机械异质性，并阻碍了可扩展的发现。

sentences.en: We introduce distribution-level unsupervised feature discovery, which discovers interpretable clusters across a prompt’s continuation distribution and provides a knob to trade off semantic granularity against mechanistic specificity, without manual target selection.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了分布级的无监督特征发现，它在提示的续写分布中发现可解释的簇，并提供一个旋钮来在语义粒度与机械特异性之间进行权衡，无需手动选择目标。

sentences.en: Our method samples continuations, represents each with (i) a semantic embedding and (ii) a mechanistic signature derived from sparse feature attributions, and clusters them via a rate–distortion objective that trades off semantic coherence and mechanistic consistency.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法对续写进行采样，用（i）语义嵌入和（ii）从稀疏特征归因导出的机械签名来表示每个续写，并通过一个在语义连贯性与机械一致性之间权衡的率-失真目标对它们进行聚类。

sentences.en: We also show that our method has cluster-level causality, which validates the discovery of cluster-level mechanistic representation.
sentences.zh: 我们还表明，我们的方法具有簇级因果性，这验证了簇级机械表征的发现。

sentences.en: Overall, our approach complements circuit analysis and behavioral evaluation by providing a scalable, unsupervised audit of the mechanisms underlying a model’s continuation distribution.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，我们的方法通过提供对模型续写分布底层机制的可扩展、无监督审计，对回路分析和行为评估形成了补充。

title_en: Sharp Concentration Bounds for Bundle-Valued Statistics on Manifolds
title_zh: 流形上束值统计量的尖锐集中界

sentences.en: Many geometric statistics and manifold learning pipelines routinely produce observations---such as tangent vectors or local frames---whose natural home is a varying family of fibers attached to different points of a base manifold, rather than a single shared vector space.
sentences.zh: 许多几何统计量和流形学习流程常常会产生一些观测——如切向量或局部框架——它们的自然归宿是附着在底流形不同点上的变化纤维族，而非单个共享向量空间。

sentences.en: Forming empirical averages requires transporting these observations to a common reference fiber, introducing curvature- and holonomy-driven effects absent from classical concentration theory.
sentences.zh: 形成经验平均值需要将这些观测传输到一个共同的参考纤维，从而引入经典集中理论中不存在的曲率和和乐（holonomy）驱动的效应。

sentences.en: We develop a non-asymptotic concentration theory for such transported empirical means, deriving finite-sample, dimension-free Hoeffding- and Bernstein-type bounds via sharp Hilbert-space inequalities.
sentences.zh: 我们为这种传输后的经验均值发展了一套非渐近集中理论，通过尖锐的Hilbert空间不等式推导出有限样本、维数无关的Hoeffding型和Bernstein型界。

sentences.en: When shortest paths to the reference point are non-unique, transport becomes path-dependent and introduces a deterministic holonomy bias; we isolate and quantify this bias through bundle curvature and loop geometry, with sharp closed-form formulas for the tangent bundle of a round sphere.
sentences.zh: 当到参考点的最短路径不唯一时，传输会变得路径相关并引入确定性和乐偏置；我们通过束曲率和环几何来隔离并量化这一偏置，并为圆球的切束给出了尖锐的闭式公式。

sentences.en: The resulting bias--variance decomposition separates the stochastic fluctuation decaying at the classical $n^{-1/2}$ rate in sample size $n$, from a curvature-driven error floor that no amount of additional data can eliminate; minimax lower bounds confirm both terms are unavoidable.
sentences.zh: 由此产生的偏置-方差分解，将按样本量$n$以经典$n^{-1/2}$速率衰减的随机波动，与无论多少额外数据都无法消除的曲率驱动误差下限分离开来；极小极大下界确认这两项都是不可避免的。

sentences.en: We further establish a robust median-of-means estimator achieving optimal rates under heavy tails, and a central limit theorem in the reference fiber.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步建立了一个在重尾下达到最优速率的稳健中位数均值估计器，以及参考纤维中的一个中心极限定理。

sentences.en: Controlled experiments on the sphere validate all theoretical predictions.
sentences.zh: 在球面上的受控实验验证了所有理论预测。

authors.name: Swagatam Das
authors.institution: Indian Statistical Institute, Dhirubhai Ambani Institute Of Information and Communication Technology

title_en: Sharp description of local minima in the loss landscape of high-dimensional two-layer ReLU neural networks
title_zh: 高维双层ReLU神经网络损失景观中局部极小值的尖锐描述

sentences.en: We study the population loss landscape of two-layer ReLU networks of the form $\sum_{k=1}^K \mathrm{ReLU}(w_k^\top x)$ in a realisable teacher–student setting with Gaussian covariates.
sentences.zh: 我们研究形如$\sum_{k=1}^K \mathrm{ReLU}(w_k^\top x)$的两层ReLU网络在带高斯协变量、可实现教师-学生设置中的总体损失景观。

sentences.en: We show that local minima admit an exact low-dimensional representation in terms of summary statistics, yielding a sharp and interpretable characterisation of the landscape.
sentences.zh: 我们表明局部极小值承认一个基于概要统计量的精确低维表示，从而得到景观的尖锐且可解释的刻画。

sentences.en: We further establish a direct link with one-pass SGD: local minima correspond to attractive fixed points of the dynamics in summary statistics space.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步建立了与单遍SGD的直接联系：局部极小值对应于概要统计量空间中动力学的吸引不动点。

sentences.en: This perspective reveals a hierarchical organisation of minima into discrete families and shows how overparameterisation changes their stability and reachability under gradient-based dynamics.
sentences.zh: 这一视角揭示了极小值按离散族分层组织，并展示了过参数化如何在基于梯度的动力学下改变它们的稳定性和可达性。

sentences.en: In this overparameterised regime, global minima become increasingly accessible, attracting the dynamics and reducing convergence to spurious solutions.
sentences.zh: 在这种过参数化机制下，全局极小值变得越来越可达，吸引动力学并减少向伪解收敛。

sentences.en: Overall, our results reveal intrinsic limitations of common simplifying assumptions, which may miss essential features of the loss landscape even in minimal neural network models.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，我们的结果揭示了常见简化假设的内在局限，即使在最简单的神经网络模型中，这些假设也可能遗漏损失景观的本质特征。

title_en: Sharp Empirical Bernstein Inequalities for the Variance of Bounded Random Variables
title_zh: 有界随机变量方差的尖锐经验Bernstein不等式

sentences.en: We develop novel "empirical Bernstein" inequalities for the variance of bounded random variables.
sentences.zh: 我们为有界随机变量的方差发展了新颖的“经验Bernstein”不等式。

sentences.en: Our inequalities hold under constant conditional variance and mean, without further assumptions like independence or identical distribution of the random variables, making them suitable for sequential decision making contexts.
sentences.zh: 我们的不等式在常数条件方差和均值下成立，无需独立同分布等进一步假设，因此适用于序贯决策场景。

sentences.en: The results are instantiated for both the batch setting (where the sample size is fixed) and the sequential setting (where the sample size is a stopping time).
sentences.zh: 结果同时实例化了批量设置（样本量固定）和序贯设置（样本量为停时）。

sentences.en: Our bounds are asymptotically "sharp": when the data are iid, our CI adapts optimally to both unknown mean $\mu$ and unknown $\mathbb{V}[(X-\mu)^2]$, meaning that the first order term of our CI exactly matches that of the oracle Bernstein inequality which knows those quantities.
sentences.zh: 我们的界是渐近“尖锐”的：当数据独立同分布时，我们的置信区间对未知均值$\mu$和未知$\mathbb{V}[(X-\mu)^2]$都进行了最优自适应，这意味着我们置信区间的一阶项与已知这些量oracle Bernstein不等式的一阶项完全匹配。

sentences.en: We compare our results to a widely used (non-sharp) concentration inequality for the variance based on self-bounding random variables, showing both the theoretical gains and improved empirical performance of our approach.
sentences.zh: 我们与一种基于自界随机变量的、被广泛使用的（非尖锐）方差集中不等式进行了比较，展示了我们的方法在理论增益和经验性能上的改进。

sentences.en: We finally extend our methods to work in any separable Hilbert space.
sentences.zh: 我们最终将我们的方法扩展到任意可分Hilbert空间。

title_en: Sharp Inequalities between Total Variation and Hellinger Distances for Gaussian Mixtures
title_zh: 高斯混合的总变差与Hellinger距离之间的尖锐不等式

sentences.en: We study the relation between the total variation (TV) and Hellinger distances between two Gaussian location mixtures.
sentences.zh: 我们研究两个高斯位置混合之间总变差（TV）与Hellinger距离的关系。

sentences.en: Our first result establishes a general upper bound: for any two mixing distributions supported on a compact set, the Hellinger distance between the two mixtures is controlled by the TV distance raised to a power $1-o(1)$, where the $o(1)$ term is of order $1/\log\log(1/\mathrm{TV})$.
sentences.zh: 我们的第一个结果确立了一个一般上界：对于任何两个支持在紧集上的混合分布，两个混合之间的Hellinger距离被TV距离的$1-o(1)$次幂控制，其中$o(1)$项的量级为$1/\log\log(1/\mathrm{TV})$。

sentences.en: We also construct two sequences of mixing distributions that demonstrate the sharpness of this bound.
sentences.zh: 我们还构造了两个混合分布序列来证明这一界的尖锐性。

sentences.en: Taken together, our results resolve an open problem raised in Jia et al. (2023) and thus lead to an entropic characterization of learning Gaussian mixtures in total variation.
sentences.zh: 综合起来，我们的结果解决了Jia等人（2023）提出的一个开放问题，从而给出了在总变差意义下学习高斯混合的一个熵特征刻画。

sentences.en: Our inequality also yields optimal robust estimation of Gaussian mixtures in Hellinger distance, which has a direct implication for bounding the minimax regret of empirical Bayes under Huber contamination.
sentences.zh: 我们的不等式还产生了在Hellinger距离下高斯混合的最优稳健估计，这对在Huber污染下经验贝叶斯极小极大遗憾的界定有直接意义。

title_en: SHARP-Q: Spectral Hessian Alignment and Rectification for Post-training Quantization
title_zh: SHARP-Q：后训练量化中的频谱Hessian对齐与校正

sentences.en: Post-training quantization (PTQ) suffers from severe accuracy degradation in ultra-low-bit regimes.
sentences.zh: 后训练量化（PTQ）在超低比特设置下会遭受严重的准确率退化。

sentences.en: To address this challenge, we propose SHARP-Q, a unified framework grounded in Information Geometry that aligns the quantization objective with the intrinsic Fisher geometry.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一挑战，我们提出了SHARP-Q，一个基于信息几何的统一框架，将量化目标与内在的Fisher几何对齐。

sentences.en: Following a "Rectify-then-Approximate" strategy, SHARP-Q first preconditions the optimization landscape via Hessian-Aware Rectification (HAR) and subsequently approximates the rectified Fisher Information Matrix through Dynamic Fisher-Subspace Compensation (DFSC).
sentences.zh: SHARP-Q遵循“先校正后近似”策略，首先通过Hessian感知校正（HAR）对优化景观进行预处理，随后通过动态Fisher子空间补偿（DFSC）逼近校正后的Fisher信息矩阵。

sentences.en: Our empirical evaluations reveal a pivotal insight: precise geometric alignment enables hardware-friendly uniform quantizers to outperform specialized non-uniform designs.
sentences.zh: 我们的实证评估揭示了一个关键洞见：精确的几何对齐使得硬件友好的均匀量化器能够胜过专门的非均匀设计。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across representative convolutional networks, Vision Transformers, and State Space Models confirm that SHARP-Q establishes new state-of-the-art results, achieving substantial accuracy gains in the challenging W2A2 and W3A3 settings.
sentences.zh: 在代表性卷积网络、视觉Transformer和状态空间模型上的大量实验证实，SHARP-Q确立了新的最先进结果，在具有挑战性的W2A2和W3A3设置中实现了显著的准确率提升。

authors.name: Li Sun
authors.institution: Ningbo Global Innovation Center, Zhejiang University

title_en: Sharper Generalization Guarantees for Asynchronous SGD: Beyond Lipschitzness, Smoothness and Data Homogeneity
title_zh: 异步SGD的更尖锐泛化保证：超越Lipschitz性、平滑性和数据同质性

sentences.en: Asynchronous stochastic gradient descent (ASGD) is widely adopted in distributed and federated learning.
sentences.zh: 异步随机梯度下降（ASGD）在分布式和联邦学习中被广泛采用。

sentences.en: In this paper, we develop a sharp generalization analysis for ASGD by leveraging the concept of on-average model stability.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们利用平均模型稳定性的概念为ASGD发展了一种尖锐的泛化分析。

sentences.en: For convex and smooth objectives, we establish stability and excess risk bounds under minimal assumptions, removing Lipschitz continuity, bounded noise, bounded parameter or data domains, while allowing randomly partitioned data and arbitrary delays.
sentences.zh: 对于凸且平滑的目标，我们在极小的假设下建立了稳定性和超额风险界，去除了Lipschitz连续性、有界噪声、有界参数或数据域的要求，同时允许随机划分的数据和任意延迟。

sentences.en: Our bounds are optimistic and explicitly characterize the impact of worker participation, recovering the minimax-optimal rate $O(1/\sqrt{mn})$ in balanced regimes where $mn$ denotes the sample size and implying fast rates under low-noise conditions.
sentences.zh: 我们的界是乐观的，并显式刻画了worker参与的影响，在平衡的设置下恢复了极小极大最优速率$O(1/\sqrt{mn})$（其中$mn$表示样本量），并在低噪声条件下蕴含快速速率。

sentences.en: We further extend the analysis to non-smooth objectives with Hölder-continuous gradients and to heterogeneous data settings via random ASGD, obtaining  non-vacuous excess risk guarantees in both settings.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步将分析扩展到具有Hölder连续梯度的非平滑目标，以及通过随机ASGD的异构数据设置，在两种设置中均获得了非平凡的冗余风险保证。

sentences.en: Experimental results support our theoretical findings.
sentences.zh: 实验结果支持了我们的理论发现。

title_en: Sharpness-Aware Minimization Can Hallucinate Minimizers
title_zh: 锐度感知最小化可能产生幻觉极小值

sentences.en: Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) is widely used to seek flatter minima—often linked to better generalization.
sentences.zh: 锐度感知最小化（SAM）被广泛用于寻找更平坦的极小值——这通常与更好的泛化相关。

sentences.en: In its standard implementation, SAM updates the current iterate using the loss gradient evaluated at a point perturbed by distance $\rho$ along the normalized gradient direction.
sentences.zh: 在其标准实现中，SAM使用在沿归一化梯度方向偏移距离$\rho$的点处评估的损失梯度来更新当前迭代。

sentences.en: We show that, for some choices of $\rho$, SAM can stall at points where this shifted (perturbed-point) gradient vanishes despite a nonzero original gradient, and therefore, they are not stationary points of the original loss.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，对于某些$\rho$的选择，SAM可能停在偏移（扰动点）梯度消失但原始梯度非零的点上，因此这些点并不是原始损失的驻点。

sentences.en: We call these points hallucinated minimizers, prove their existence under simple nonconvex landscape conditions (e.g., the presence of a local minimizer and a local maximizer), and establish sufficient conditions for local convergence of the SAM iterates to them.
sentences.zh: 我们将这些点称为幻觉极小值，在简单的非凸景观条件（例如存在一个局部极小值和一个局部极大值）下证明它们的存在性，并建立了SAM迭代局部收敛到这些点的充分条件。

sentences.en: We corroborate this failure mode in neural network training and observe that it aligns with SAM's performance degradation often seen at large $\rho$.
sentences.zh: 我们在神经网络训练中验证了这一失败模式，并观察到它与SAM在较大$\rho$下常出现的性能退化一致。

sentences.en: Finally, as a practical safeguard, we find that a short initial SGD warm-start before enabling SAM mitigates this failure mode and reduces sensitivity to the choice of $\rho$.
sentences.zh: 最后，作为一种实用防护措施，我们发现启动SAM之前先进行一段短暂的SGD热启动可以缓解这一失败模式，并降低对$\rho$选择的敏感性。

title_en: Sharpness-Aware Pretraining Mitigates Catastrophic Forgetting
title_zh: 锐度感知预训练缓解灾难性遗忘

sentences.en: Pretraining optimizers are tuned to produce the strongest possible base model, on the assumption that a stronger starting point yields a stronger model after subsequent changes like post-training and quantization.
sentences.zh: 预训练优化器的调参旨在产生尽可能强的基础模型，其假设是更强的起点能在后续变化（如后训练和量化）之后产生更强的模型。

sentences.en: This overlooks the geometry of the base model which controls how much of the base model's capabilities survive subsequent parameter updates.
sentences.zh: 这忽视了控制基础模型能力在后续参数更新中存活多少的基础模型几何形态。

sentences.en: We study three pretraining optimization approaches that bias optimization toward flatter minima: Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM), large learning rates, and shortened learning rate annealing periods.
sentences.zh: 我们研究了三种偏向优化以获得更平坦极小值的预训练优化方法：锐度感知最小化（SAM）、大学习率以及缩短的学习率退火周期。

sentences.en: Across model sizes ranging from 20M to 150M parameters, we find that these interventions consistently improve downstream performance after post-training on five common datasets with up to 80\% less forgetting.
sentences.zh: 在从20M到150M参数的各种模型规模上，我们发现这些干预措施在五个常见数据集上后训练后一贯改善下游性能，遗忘最多减少80\%。

sentences.en: These principles hold at scale: a short SAM mid-training phase applied to an existing OLMo-2-1B checkpoint reduces forgetting by 31\% after MetaMath post-training and by 40\% after 4-bit quantization.
sentences.zh: 这些原则在大规模上同样成立：将一段短暂的SAM训练中期阶段应用于现有的OLMo-2-1B检查点，在MetaMath后训练后遗忘减少31\%，在4比特量化后减少40\%。

title_en: Sheaf Neural Networks on SPD Manifolds: Second-Order Geometric Representation Learning
title_zh: SPD流形上的层神经网络：二阶几何表示学习

sentences.en: Graph neural networks face two fundamental challenges rooted in the linear structure of Euclidean vector spaces: (1) Current  architectures represent geometry through vectors (directions, gradients), yet many tasks require matrix-valued representations that capture relationships between directions—such as how atomic orientations covary in a molecule.
sentences.zh: 图神经网络面临两个植根于欧几里得向量空间线性结构的基本挑战：（1）当前的架构通过向量（方向、梯度）表示几何，但许多任务需要矩阵值的表示来捕捉方向之间的关系——例如分子中原子的取向如何协同变化。

sentences.en: These second-order representations are naturally  captured by points on the symmetric positive definite matrices (SPD) manifold;
sentences.zh: 这些二阶表示自然地由对称正定矩阵（SPD）流形上的点捕捉；

sentences.en: (2) Standard message passing applies shared transformations across edges.
sentences.zh: （2）标准的消息传递在边之间应用共享变换。

sentences.en: Sheaf neural networks address this via edge-specific transformations, but existing formulations remain confined to vector spaces and therefore cannot propagate matrix-valued features.
sentences.zh: 层神经网络通过边特定变换来解决这一问题，但现有形式仍然局限于向量空间，因而无法传播矩阵值特征。

sentences.en: We address both challenges by developing the first  sheaf neural network operates natively on the SPD manifold.
sentences.zh: 我们通过开发首个原生运行在SPD流形上的层神经网络来应对这两个挑战。

sentences.en: Our key insight is that the SPD manifold admits a Lie group structure, enabling well-posed analogs of sheaf operators without projecting to Euclidean space.
sentences.zh: 我们的关键洞见是，SPD流形承认一个Lie群结构，使得无需投影到欧几里得空间即可获得层算子良定义的模拟。

sentences.en: Theoretically, we prove that SPD-valued sheaves are strictly more expressive than Euclidean sheaves: they admit consistent configurations (global sections) that vector-valued  sheaves cannot represent, directly translating to richer learned representations.
sentences.zh: 在理论上，我们证明SPD值层严格比欧几里得层更具表达能力：它们承认向量值层无法表示的一致配置（全局截面），这直接转化为更丰富的学习表示。

sentences.en: Empirically, our sheaf convolution  transforms effectively rank-1 directional inputs into full-rank matrices encoding local geometric structure.
sentences.zh: 在经验上，我们的层卷积变换能有效地将秩1方向输入转化为编码局部几何结构的满秩矩阵。

sentences.en: Our dual-stream architecture achieves SOTA on 6/7 MoleculeNet benchmarks, with the sheaf framework providing consistent depth robustness.
sentences.zh: 我们的双流架构在6/7个MoleculeNet基准上达到了SOTA，层框架提供了一致性的深度鲁棒性。

authors.institution: national university of singaore, National University of Singapore

authors.institution: Max Planck Institute for Mathematics in the Sciences, Max-Planck Institute

title_en: SHERPA: Fine-tuning Segment Anything Models with Task-relevant Guidance
title_zh: SHERPA：带任务相关引导的Segment Anything模型微调

sentences.en: Segment Anything Models (SAMs) often struggle with certain specialized tasks.
sentences.zh: Segment Anything模型（SAM）在某些专门任务上往往表现困难。

sentences.en: A common approach is to fine-tune models with specific task labels, but this often leads to overfitting, introduces model bias and significantly degrades their generalization ability.
sentences.zh: 常见的方法是使用特定任务标签对模型进行微调，但这往往导致过拟合，引入模型偏差，并显著削弱其泛化能力。

sentences.en: To overcome these challenges, we propose SHERPA, a novel framework that leverages a smaller SAM to guide the fine-tuning of a larger SAM via task-relevant features.
sentences.zh: 为克服这些挑战，我们提出了SHERPA，一个利用较小SAM通过任务相关特征引导较大SAM微调的新颖框架。

sentences.en: Specifically, we first leverage the Fisher Ratio Separation (FRS) module to separate high task-relevant features and preserve the ability of the large SAM to perform other general tasks.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们首先利用Fisher比率分离（FRS）模块分离高任务相关特征，并保留大型SAM执行其他通用任务的能力。

sentences.en: Then, the Guiding Feature Extraction (GFE) module is used to extract representative guiding features from the fine-tuned small SAMs.
sentences.zh: 然后，使用引导特征提取（GFE）模块从微调后的小型SAM中提取代表性引导特征。

sentences.en: We leverage small SAMs tailored for specific tasks (including natural image segmentation, biomedical image segmentation, and video object segmentation) as guidance and then evaluate the SHERPA scheme to fine-tune larger SAM series models.
sentences.zh: 我们利用针对特定任务（包括自然图像分割、生物医学图像分割和视频对象分割）量身定制的小型SAM作为引导，然后评估SHERPA方案以微调系列更大SAM模型。

sentences.en: Our experiments demonstrate that SHERPA enhances the retention of generalization ability across those diverse tasks, by up to 11.1\%, and improves specific task performance by up to 2.2\%.
sentences.zh: 我们的实验表明，SHERPA在这些多样化任务上增强了对泛化能力的保持，最多提升11.1\%，并将特定任务性能提升最多2.2\%。

title_en: Shift-Dependent Asymmetry: Orthogonal Inverse Low-Rank Adaptation for Federated Medical Segmentation
title_zh: 偏移相关不对称性：用于联邦医学分割的正交逆低秩适配

sentences.en: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) enables efficient federated fine-tuning of segmentation foundation models for medical imaging.
sentences.zh: 低秩适配（LoRA）实现了医学影像分割基础模型的高效联邦微调。

sentences.en: However, most federated LoRA methods adopt a uniform aggregation rule, which breaks under the encoder–decoder asymmetry in medical segmentation: the encoder is dominated by appearance shifts, while the decoder is dominated by supervision variations.
sentences.zh: 然而，大多数联邦LoRA方法采用统一的聚合规则，这会在医学分割的编码器-解码器不对称性下失效：编码器主要受外观偏移主导，而解码器主要受监督变化主导。

sentences.en: This mismatch entangles shared anatomy with site-specific biases and harms generalization.
sentences.zh: 这种错配将共享解剖结构与站点特定偏差纠缠在一起，损害了泛化能力。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose Inverse Asymmetric Tuning (IAT).
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了逆不对称调优（IAT）。

sentences.en: IAT aligns adaptation with heterogeneity sources by personalizing module-specific components in the encoder to absorb appearance shifts and in the decoder to accommodate site-dependent supervision, while retaining a shared pathway for transferable consensus.
sentences.zh: IAT通过个性化编码器中模块特定组件以吸收外观偏移、在解码器中以适应站点特定监督，将适配与异构来源对齐，同时保留一条共享通路用于可迁移的共识。

sentences.en: However, structural separation alone is insufficient under LoRA’s bilinear parameterization, where multiplicative coupling can still cause site-specific updates to leak into the shared direction.
sentences.zh: 然而，在LoRA的双线性参数化下，仅靠结构分离是不够的，因为乘法耦合仍可能导致站点特定更新渗入共享方向。

sentences.en: We therefore introduce a Subspace Orthogonality Regularizer that penalizes shared–local collinearity in the effective update space, mitigating leakage without extra communication.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们引入了一个子空间正交正则化器，在有效更新空间中惩罚共享-局部的共线性，从而无需额外通信即可缓解泄漏。

sentences.en: Experiments show consistent improvements over strong federated LoRA and parameter-efficient FL baselines.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，相较现有的强联邦LoRA和参数高效FL基线，我们的方法取得了一致的改进。

title_en: Shifting the Breaking Point of Flow Matching for Multi-Instance Editing
title_zh: 为多实例编辑移动流匹配的突破点

sentences.en: Flow matching models have recently emerged as an efficient alternative to diffusion, especially for text-guided image generation and editing, offering faster inference through continuous-time dynamics.
sentences.zh: 流匹配模型近来作为扩散的高效替代方案出现，尤其适用于文本引导的图像生成与编辑，它通过连续时间动力学提供更快的推理。

sentences.en: However, existing flow-based editors predominantly support global or single-instruction edits and struggle with multi-instance scenarios, where multiple parts of a reference input must be edited independently without semantic interference.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的基于流的编辑器主要支持全局或单指令编辑，在多实例场景下存在困难，此时参考输入的多个部分必须独立编辑而不产生语义干扰。

sentences.en: We identify this limitation as a consequence of globally conditioned velocity fields and joint attention mechanisms, which entangle concurrent edits.
sentences.zh: 我们将这一局限归因于全局条件化的速度场和联合注意力机制，它们会将并发编辑纠缠在一起。

sentences.en: To address this issue, we introduce Instance-Disentangled Attention, a mechanism that partitions joint attention operations, enforcing binding between instance-specific textual instructions and spatial regions during velocity field estimation.
sentences.zh: 为解决该问题，我们引入了实例解缠注意力，一种划分联合注意力操作的机制，在速度场估计期间强制执行实例特定文本指令与空间区域之间的绑定。

sentences.en: We evaluate our approach on both natural image editing and a newly introduced benchmark of text-dense infographics with region-level editing instructions.
sentences.zh: 我们在自然图像编辑和新引入的、带区域级编辑指令的文本密集信息图基准上评估了我们的方法。

sentences.en: Experimental results demonstrate that our approach promotes edit disentanglement and locality while preserving global output coherence, enabling single-pass, instance-level editing.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，我们的方法在保持全局输出连贯性的同时促进了编辑解缠与局部性，实现了单遍、实例级编辑。

title_en: SHINE: A Scalable In-Context Hypernetwork for Mapping Context to LoRA in a Single Pass
title_zh: SHINE：一种可扩展的上下文内超网络，单遍将上下文映射为LoRA

sentences.en: We propose SHINE (Scalable Hyper In-context NEtwork), a scalable hypernetwork that can map diverse meaningful contexts into high-quality LoRA adapters for large language models (LLM).
sentences.zh: 我们提出了SHINE（可扩展超上下文内网络），一个可扩展的超网络，能够将多样的有意义上下文映射为大语言模型（LLM）的高质量LoRA适配器。

sentences.en: By reusing the frozen LLM's own parameters in an in-context hypernetwork design and introducing architectural innovations, SHINE overcomes key limitations of prior hypernetworks and achieves strong expressive power with a relatively small number of parameters.
sentences.zh: 通过在上下文内超网络设计中复用冻结LLM自身的参数，并引入架构创新，SHINE克服了先前超网络的关键局限，以相对较少量的参数实现了强大的表达能力。

sentences.en: We introduce a pretraining and instruction fine-tuning pipeline, and train our hypernetwork to generate high quality LoRA adapters from diverse meaningful contexts in a single forward pass.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了一个预训练和指令微调流程，并训练我们的超网络在单次前向中从多样化的有意义上下文中生成高质量的LoRA适配器。

sentences.en: It updates LLM parameters without any fine-tuning, and immediately enables complex question answering tasks related to the context without directly accessing the context, effectively transforming in-context knowledge to in-parameter knowledge in one pass.
sentences.zh: 它在无需任何微调的情况下更新LLM参数，并立即启用与上下文相关的复杂问答任务，而无需直接访问上下文，从而高效地将上下文内知识在单遍中转化为参数内知识。

sentences.en: Our work achieves outstanding results on various tasks, greatly saves time, computation and memory costs compared to SFT-based LLM adaptation, and shows great potential for scaling.
sentences.zh: 我们的工作在多种任务上取得了卓越的结果，相比基于SFT的LLM适配，大幅节省了时间、计算和内存成本，并展现出巨大的扩展潜力。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/metalora-734E
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/metalora-734E 获取。

title_en: Short Chains, Deep Thoughts: Balancing Reasoning Efficiency and Intra-Segment Capability via Split-Merge Optimization
title_zh: 短链深思：通过拆分-合并优化平衡推理效率与段内能力

sentences.en: While Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in solving complex tasks through the generation of long reasoning chains, this reliance on verbose generation results in significant latency and computational overhead.
sentences.zh: 虽然大型推理模型（LRM）已通过生成长推理链展现出解决复杂任务的惊人能力，但对冗长生成的依赖会导致显著的延迟和计算开销。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{CoSMo} (\textbf{Co}nsistency-Guided \textbf{S}plit-\textbf{M}erge \textbf{O}ptimization), a framework designed to eliminate structural redundancy rather than indiscriminately restricting token volume.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了\textbf{CoSMo}（\textbf{Co}nsistency-Guided \textbf{S}plit-\textbf{M}erge \textbf{O}ptimization，一致性引导的拆分-合并优化），一个旨在消除结构冗余而非无差别限制token量的框架。

sentences.en: Specifically, CoSMo utilizes a split-merge algorithm that dynamically refines reasoning chains by merging redundant segments and splitting logical gaps to ensure coherence.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，CoSMo利用拆分-合并算法，通过合并冗余段和拆分逻辑缺口动态精化推理链，以确保连贯性。

sentences.en: We then employ structure-aligned reinforcement learning with a novel segment-level budget to supervise the model in maintaining efficient reasoning structures throughout training.
sentences.zh: 然后我们采用结构对齐的强化学习，并配备新颖的段级预算，在整个训练过程中监督模型维持高效的推理结构。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks and backbones demonstrate that CoSMo achieves superior performance, improving accuracy by \textbf{3.3} points while reducing segment usage by \textbf{28.7\%} on average compared to reasoning efficiency baselines.
sentences.zh: 在多个基准和骨干网络上的大量实验表明，CoSMo取得了卓越的性能，与推理效率基线相比，准确率平均提升\textbf{3.3}个百分点，同时段使用量平均减少\textbf{28.7\%}。

title_en: Shortcut-Resistant CAM Distillation for Long-Tailed Recognition
title_zh: 面向长尾识别的抗捷径CAM蒸馏

sentences.en: Real-world datasets often follow a long-tailed distribution, making generalization to tail classes difficult.
sentences.zh: 真实世界的数据集通常遵循长尾分布，使得对尾部类别的泛化变得困难。

sentences.en: We revisit this problem through the lens of shortcut learning, where models prefer the easiest predictive cues (e.g., background or textures) over object-centric semantics, especially under scarce and biased supervision.
sentences.zh: 我们通过捷径学习的视角重新审视这一问题，即模型倾向于选择最容易的预测线索（如背景或纹理）而非以对象为中心的语义，尤其是在监督稀缺且有偏的情况下。

sentences.en: We find that this tendency is amplified for tail classes: limited examples often share similar contexts, making non-semantic signals highly correlated and thus tempting shortcuts, whereas head classes with diverse appearances and environments encourage more stable object-focused representations.
sentences.zh: 我们发现这种倾向在尾部类别上被放大：有限的样本往往共享相似的上下文，使得非语义信号高度相关，从而诱使模型走捷径；而外观和环境多样化的头部类别则鼓励更稳定的以对象为中心的表示。

sentences.en: Motivated by this observation, we propose Shortcut-Resistant CAM Distillation (SRCD), a plug-and-play framework that transfers object-focused explanations from head to tail classes.
sentences.zh: 受这一观察启发，我们提出了抗捷径CAM蒸馏（SRCD），一个将对象为中心的说明从头部类别迁移到尾部类别的即插即用框架。

sentences.en: SRCD operates in the Class Activation Map (CAM) space, where a CAM provides a class-specific spatial evidence map for a prediction.
sentences.zh: SRCD在类激活映射（CAM）空间中运行，其中CAM为预测提供类特定的空间证据图。

sentences.en: SRCD aggregates CAMs from a small set of head-class candidates into a shortcut-resistant teacher using an energy-model weighting based on coherence and concentration, and distills it to the tail-class CAM.
sentences.zh: SRCD使用基于连贯性和集中度的能量模型权重，将一小部分头部类候选的CAM聚合为一个抗捷径教师，并将其蒸馏到尾部类别的CAM中。

sentences.en: We provide a theoretical analysis that quantifies shortcut reliance as shortcut-region evidence mass in CAM space and shows that SRCD suppresses tail shortcuts.
sentences.zh: 我们提供了一项理论分析，将捷径依赖量化为CAM空间中的捷径区域证据质量，并表明SRCD能抑制尾部捷径。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on long-tailed benchmarks consistently improve strong baselines.
sentences.zh: 在长尾基准上的大量实验持续改进了强基线。

sentences.en: The code is available at \url{https://github.com/Haifeng3/SRCD}.
sentences.zh: 代码可在\url{https://github.com/Haifeng3/SRCD}获取。

title_en: Should I Have Expressed a Different Intent? Counterfactual Generation for LLM-Based Autonomous Control
title_zh: 我是否应该表达不同的意图？基于LLM的自主控制中的反事实生成

sentences.en: Large language model (LLM)-powered agents can translate high-level user intents into plans and actions in an environment.
sentences.zh: 由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的智能体可以将高层用户意图转化为环境中的计划和行动。

sentences.en: Yet after observing an outcome, users may wonder: What if I had phrased my intent differently?
sentences.zh: 然而在观察到结果后，用户可能会想：如果我用不同的方式表述我的意图会怎样？

sentences.en: We introduce a framework that enables such counterfactual reasoning in agentic LLM-driven control scenarios, while providing formal reliability guarantees.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了一个框架，使得在智能体LLM驱动的控制场景中能够进行这种反事实推理，同时提供形式的可靠性保证。

sentences.en: Our approach models the closed-loop interaction between a user, an LLM-based agent, and an environment as a structural causal model (SCM), and leverages test-time scaling to generate multiple candidate counterfactual outcomes via probabilistic abduction.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法将用户、基于LLM的智能体与环境之间的闭环交互建模为一个结构因果模型（SCM），并利用测试时扩展，通过概率溯因生成多个候选反事实结果。

sentences.en: Through an offline calibration phase, the proposed conformal counterfactual generation (CCG) yields sets of counterfactual outcomes that are guaranteed to contain the true counterfactual outcome with high probability.
sentences.zh: 通过离线校准阶段，所提出的保形反事实生成（CCG）产生反事实结果集，这些集合被保证以高概率包含真实的反事实结果。

sentences.en: We showcase the performance of CCG on a wireless network control use case, demonstrating significant advantages compared to naive re-execution baselines.
sentences.zh: 我们展示了CCG在一个无线网络控制用例上的性能，与朴素的重新执行基线相比表现出显著优势。

title_en: Show, Don't Tell: Morphing Latent Reasoning into Image Generation
title_zh: 演示而非言说：将潜在推理变形为图像生成

sentences.en: Text-to-image (T2I) generation has achieved remarkable progress, yet existing methods often lack the ability to dynamically reason and refine during generation--a hallmark of human creativity.
sentences.zh: 文本到图像（T2I）生成已取得显著进展，但现有方法往往缺乏在生成过程中动态推理和精化的能力——这是人类创造力的一个标志。

sentences.en: Current reasoning-augmented paradigms mostly rely on explicit thought processes, where intermediate reasoning is decoded into discrete text at fixed steps with frequent image decoding and re-encoding, leading to inefficiencies, information loss, and cognitive mismatches.
sentences.zh: 当前的推理增强范式大多依赖显式的思维过程，中间推理在固定步骤被解码为离散文本，并频繁进行图像解码和重新编码，从而导致效率低下、信息丢失和认知不匹配。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we introduce **LatentMorph**, a novel framework that seamlessly integrates implicit latent reasoning into the T2I generation process.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一差距，我们引入了**LatentMorph**，一个将隐式潜在推理无缝集成到T2I生成过程中的新颖框架。

sentences.en: At its core, LatentMorph introduces four lightweight components: (***i***) a **condenser** for summarizing intermediate generation states into compact visual memory, (***ii***) a **translator** for converting latent thoughts into actionable guidance, (***iii***) a **shaper** for dynamically steering next image token predictions, and (***iv***) an RL-trained **invoker** for adaptively determining when to invoke reasoning.
sentences.zh: 其核心是，LatentMorph引入了四个轻量级组件：（***I***）**condenser**（冷凝器），将中间生成状态概括为紧凑的视觉记忆；（***ii***）**translator**（翻译器），将潜在思维转换为可执行的指导；（***iii***）**shaper**（塑造器），动态引导下一个图像token的预测；（***iv***）一个经RL训练的**invoker**（调用器），自适应地决定何时调用推理。

sentences.en: By performing reasoning entirely in continuous latent spaces, LatentMorph avoids the bottlenecks of explicit reasoning and enables more adaptive self-refinement.
sentences.zh: 通过完全在连续潜在空间中进行推理，LatentMorph避免了显式推理的瓶颈，并实现了更自适应的自我精化。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that LatentMorph **(I)** enhances the base model Janus-Pro by 16% on GenEval and 25% on T2I-CompBench;
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，LatentMorph **（I）**在GenEval上将基础模型Janus-Pro提升了16%，在T2I-CompBench上提升了25%；

sentences.en: **(II)** outperforms explicit paradigms (*e.g.*, TwiG) by 15% and 11% on abstract reasoning tasks like WISE and IPV-Txt, **(III)** while reducing inference time by 44% and token consumption by 51%; and **(IV)** exhibits 71% cognitive alignment with human intuition on reasoning invocation.
sentences.zh: **（II）**在WISE和IPV-Txt等抽象推理任务上比显式范式（*例如*，TwiG）高出15%和11%，**（III）**同时将推理时间减少44%、token消耗减少51%；并且**（IV）**在推理调用上表现出与人类直觉71%的认知一致性。
